# Real Store/auth/controller/RPC and CLI; native observations are MODELED.
! skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE serve up invalid.yaml --name bad --target kube
stderr 'replicas outside 1..8'
service-records 0

skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE serve up two.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id first --request-domain $DOMAIN
stdout 'web +kube +1 +present +creating'
service-id ID web
service-records 1
skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE serve up two.yaml --name web --target kube --request-id first --request-domain $DOMAIN
service-records 1
! skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE serve up eight.yaml --name extra --target kube --request-id second --request-domain $DOMAIN
stderr 'capacity'
service-records 1
service-step
skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE --json serve status $ID
stdout '"desired_replicas": *2'
stdout '"ready_replicas": *2'
stdout '"phase": *"SERVICE_PHASE_READY"'
service-forward $ID response.txt
cmp response.txt expected.txt
skygo --token-file $TOKEN_FILE serve down $ID
stdout 'absent +deleting'
service-step
service-records 0

-- two.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}
scaling: {replicas: 2}
-- eight.yaml --

argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}

-- invalid.yaml --
image: registry.example.com/team/web@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
argv: [/bin/web]
port: 8080
readiness: {path: /healthz}
resources: {cpu_millis: 250, memory_bytes: 268435456}
scaling: {replicas: 9}
-- expected.txt --
replicas=2
